audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1, 2, 5 and 6 read Volibear / Volibear / Volibear / Skill in both layers while the packet chart gives Skill / Skill / Yorick / Yorick. The whys already said 'Level 2 stays even', 'Level 3 remains skill-dependent', 'First item swings to Yorick' and 'Late game Yorick out-scales', so four rows printed a token against their own sentence.
audit.why: Levels 2-3 are genuinely even: Last Rites (6/5.5/5/4.5/4s) heals him on every empowered attack and his Mist Walkers soak the Frenzied Maul bite, so neither side wins cleanly until you can clear ghouls and still commit. From first item the Maiden of the Mist plus a full ghoul line out-DPS you in a straight trade, and late he out-splits you with Maiden while Dark Procession peels the engage.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2, 5 and 6 set to the packet sides in both layers as one atomic group, ratings moved to 5/10, 5/10, 4/10 and 3/10, and all four full-layer whys rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].why and phases[6].why both gave the item stages to Volibear ('Force Yorick to fight or lose the wave', 'a drain-tank Yorick can't burst'), and neither mentioned the Maiden — the only thing that actually moves those stages.
audit.why: Eulogy of the Isles (160/130/100s) summons the Maiden, which makes Yorick's attacks on her target hit harder and raises Walkers from dead enemies. That is a sustained-DPS and wave-pressure spike, not a burst one, so 'you're a drain-tank he can't burst' misreads the threat entirely. Content spikes[2] and late already said the lane tilts to him here.
audit.corrected: phases[5].why now names Maiden plus the ghoul line and the fight-when-Maiden-is-dead rule; phases[6].why names the split-push and tells you to take priority rather than duel his summons.

audit.whatIsWrong: Yorick's cage is attributed to the wrong slot in eight content fields — whys[4], spikes[0].text, spikes[1].text, early, mid, wants.you[1] and wants.foe[0] all call it his E (one of them 'E Mourning Mist cage'). Separately, Volibear's Q is called a slow in whys[3], spikes[0].text and early.
audit.why: Dark Procession (W, 20/18/16/14/12s, 600 range) is the destructible wall that blocks movement — that is the cage. Mourning Mist (E, 12/11/10/9/8s, 700 range) is a thrown globule that reduces armour, damages, slows and marks you so his summons sprint at the mark; it cages nothing. The two abilities have different cooldowns, so a player timing his all-in off 'his E cage' is counting the wrong timer by up to 8 seconds and walks into a live wall. Thundering Smash (Q) stuns; the slows in Volibear's kit are Sky Splitter (E) and Stormbringer (R).
audit.corrected: Every cage reference moved to W / Dark Procession, with the 16s rank-3 cooldown added to content.mid; Mourning Mist left described as the slow-and-mark it is; all three 'Q slow' references corrected to the Q stun.

notes: The cage was attributed to the wrong ability slot in eight content fields. Dark Procession is W (20/18/16/14/12s) and is the wall; Mourning Mist is E (12/11/10/9/8s) and only slows, shreds armour and marks you for his summons. A player timing the all-in off 'his E cage' is watching a timer up to 8 seconds shorter than the real one and walks into a live wall — the single most punishing error on this page. The full layer had it right (it names Dark Procession throughout), so this was a layer-to-layer contradiction as well. Four chart rows also realigned to the packet in both layers, and three 'Q slow' references corrected to the Q stun.
